_comment: Maps Claude Code hook events -> Codex hook events. Used by translate.js when porting hooks.json. VERIFIED 2026-10-13 against docs/reference/platform-facts-2026-10.md §3.3 (Codex CLI 0.162.1). Codex supports exactly 12 hook events: SessionStart, SubagentStart, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, PreCompact, PostCompact, UserPromptSubmit, SubagentStop, Stop, SessionEnd, Interrupt. Eleven share their Claude Code name; Interrupt has no Claude Code equivalent and is listed under codex_only. Every Claude-only event needs an explicit drop row: translate.js passes an event with no row through unchanged. The 2026-07-22 revision listed 10 events and dropped SessionEnd; Codex has since added SessionEnd and Interrupt.

PreToolUse.note: Codex fires for Bash, apply_patch, MCP tool calls. ApplyPatchHandler bug exists per openai/codex#16732.

PermissionRequest.note: Fires when Codex asks the user to approve a tool call. Previously only reached the Codex output via translateHooks' no-mapping passthrough path -- now explicit.

SubagentStart.note: Verified supported 2026-07-22 -- corrects the prior assumption that Codex has no per-subagent lifecycle events. Revives Mission Control's subagent-start-tracker.js writer on Codex.

SubagentStop.note: Verified supported 2026-07-22 -- corrects the prior 'drop' status (which assumed subagent results return to the parent context with no separate stop event). Revives Mission Control's agent-run-logger.js writer (agent-runs / subagent-costs) on Codex.

PreCompact.note: Verified supported 2026-07-22 -- corrects the prior 'drop' status.

PostCompact.note: Verified supported 2026-07-22 -- new entry; this map previously had no PostCompact row at all.

SessionEnd.note: Added to Codex's hook surface (facts §3.3). Codex SessionEnd timeout defaults to 1 s with a 3 s maximum, so translated SessionEnd handlers must be clamped to <= 3 s and stay quick.

Notification.note: No Codex equivalent. macOS notification handlers must move to launchd or a separate daemon.

PermissionDenied.note: Claude-only event (added to Claude Code after the 23-event set); not in Codex's 12-event surface.

MessageDisplay.note: Claude-only event (added to Claude Code after the 23-event set); not in Codex's 12-event surface.

schema_compat.command_format: Both use { type: 'command', command: '<path>' } -- JSON identical.
schema_compat.matcher_field: Both support regex matcher. Use '*' or omit for all events.
schema_compat.stdin_payload: Both pipe JSON to stdin. Field names mostly match. Verify per-event schema in Codex hooks reference.
schema_compat.env_vars: Codex plugin hook commands receive PLUGIN_ROOT + PLUGIN_DATA (native) AND CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT + CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA ('for compatibility with existing plugin hooks' -- learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks). CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT is NOT a real Codex variable; a prior version of this adapter rewrote hook/skill bodies to reference it, which broke every generated hook and skill instruction that touched the plugin root. Fixed 2026-07-22: hook commands and skill bodies now keep ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} verbatim.
schema_compat.async_handlers: A handler with "async": true is parsed by Codex but skipped ('asynchronous command hooks aren't supported yet'). Async handlers must translate to synchronous: translate.js strips the async flag so the handler still runs, synchronously, instead of being silently dropped.
schema_compat.unsupported_handler_fields: Codex handlers have no `args` (exec form), `onFailure`, `if`, or `once`. Commander keeps shell-form `command` strings with a quoted "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" so one hooks.json mirrors to Codex, and never sets onFailure: "block".
schema_compat.passthrough_handler_fields: `statusMessage` and `additionalContextLimit` (default 2500 tokens) are Codex handler fields and pass through translation unchanged; so do `type`, `command`, `commandWindows`, `timeout` and `matcher` (ignored on UserPromptSubmit, Stop and Interrupt).

Interrupt.note: Fires when the user interrupts a Codex turn. No Claude Code equivalent, so no Claude hooks.json entry translates to it. matcher is ignored; timeout defaults to 1 s, max 3 s.
